domain.description: Synthetic UK water customer, asset, leakage incident, repair, inspection, service interruption, and performance analytics.

tables.description: One row per fictional water service account holder; customer and account holder are synonyms.

columns.name: Account Holder Name
columns.description: Fictional account label, never a real identity.

tables.description: One row per fictional maintainable water asset with broad region and no precise location.

columns.name: Criticality
columns.description: Demonstration analytical classification, not an operational risk rating.

tables.description: One row per fictional leakage or service incident affecting one primary asset and optionally one customer.

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: Critical, High, Medium, or Low; high severity means Critical or High.

columns.name: Estimated Leakage Volume
columns.description: Estimated synthetic leakage volume in cubic metres.

columns.name: Repeat Incident Flag
columns.description: True when the asset had an earlier incident in the prior 30 days.

tables.description: One row per fictional repair work order belonging to one incident.

columns.name: Priority
columns.description: Demonstration scheduling priority, not field direction.

columns.name: Work Completed At
columns.description: Synthetic completion timestamp for completed work.

columns.name: Crew Region
columns.description: Broad reporting region without team identities or locations.

tables.description: One row per fictional inspection of one water asset.

columns.name: Follow-up Required
columns.description: Demonstration follow-up flag, not field direction.

tables.description: Customer-level incident and interruption classification for routing demonstrations.
Asset-level latest-inspection and active-incident classification for routing demonstrations.
Work-order-level repair duration and completion classification for routing demonstrations.

measures.name: Open Incidents
measures.description: Incidents whose status is Open or Investigating.

measures.name: Total Estimated Leakage
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM(Incidents[Estimated Leakage Volume]), Incidents[Incident Status] IN {"Open", "Investigating"})
measures.description: Estimated leakage volume for active incidents in cubic metres.

measures.name: Average Repair Duration
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(FILTER('Work Orders', 'Work Orders'[Work Order Status] = "Completed" && NOT ISBLANK('Work Orders'[Work Started At]) && NOT ISBLANK('Work Orders'[Work Completed At])), DATEDIFF('Work Orders'[Work Started At], 'Work Orders'[Work Completed At], MINUTE) / 60.0)
measures.description: Average hours from start to completion for completed work orders.

measures.name: Repeat Incidents
measures.description: Incidents on an asset with another earlier incident in the prior 30 days.

measures.name: Work Completed On Time
measures.expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Work Orders'), 'Work Orders'[Work Order Status] = "Completed", 'Work Orders'[Work Completed At] <= 'Work Orders'[Promised Completion At]), CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Work Orders'), 'Work Orders'[Work Order Status] = "Completed"), 0)
measures.description: Percentage of completed work orders completed on or before promise.

measures.name: Assets Requiring Attention
measures.expression: SUMX(FILTER(Assets, Assets[Asset Status] = "Active"), VAR CurrentAsset = Assets[Asset ID] VAR HighOpen = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Incidents), Incidents[Incident Status] IN {"Open", "Investigating"}, Incidents[Severity] IN {"Critical", "High"}) VAR LatestInspection = CALCULATE(MAX(Inspections[Inspected At])) VAR LatestFailed = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Inspections), Inspections[Inspected At] = LatestInspection, Inspections[Inspection Result] = "Failed") RETURN IF(HighOpen > 0 || LatestFailed > 0, 1, 0))
measures.description: Active assets with an open high-severity incident or failed latest inspection.

measures.name: Customers Affected
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Incidents[Customer ID]), Incidents[Incident Status] IN {"Open", "Investigating"}, Incidents[Customer ID] <> BLANK())

ai.instructions:
Business rules:
- Customer and account holder are synonyms. Incident, event, and issue are synonyms. Repair and work order are related but not synonyms.
- Active incidents have status Open or Investigating. High severity means Critical or High.
- Use explicit governed measures for leakage, repair duration, repeat incidents, on-time work, and assets requiring attention.
Safety and privacy:
- All records are synthetic. Do not imply live status or regulatory compliance.
- Do not direct field operations or provide safety-critical, credential, precise-location, vulnerability, or maintenance-approval advice.

verifiedAnswerCandidates.question: How many open incidents do we have?
What is total estimated leakage for active incidents?
What percentage of completed work was on time?
How many assets require attention?
verifiedAnswerCandidates.description: Governed combined incident and inspection rule.

agent.description: Synthetic Water Utilities Operations agent for governed performance metrics and prepared routing analysis.
agent.instructions: Use WaterUtilitiesSemanticModel for standard governed KPIs. Use WaterUtilitiesDemo only for service-impact segments, asset attention bands, and repair performance bands. Prefer one source. State that data is synthetic when confusion with live operations is possible. Never direct safety-critical operations or claim compliance.

sources.name: WaterUtilitiesSemanticModel
sources.description: Optimized Direct Lake model for standard governed customer, asset, incident, repair, inspection, leakage, interruption, and performance questions.
sources.instructions: Use the explicit governed measures and model relationships.

sources.name: WaterUtilitiesDemo
sources.description: Prepared synthetic marts for customer service-impact segments, asset attention bands, and repair performance bands.
sources.instructions: Use only for routing classifications and prepared cross-entity scenarios.

examples.question: Which customers are in the high impact segment?
examples.query: SELECT customer_id, account_holder_name, active_incidents, service_interruption_hours FROM routing_customer_service_impact WHERE service_impact_segment = 'High Impact' ORDER BY customer_id

examples.question: Which assets need immediate review?
examples.query: SELECT asset_id, asset_type, active_high_severity_incidents, latest_inspection_result FROM routing_asset_attention_scorecard WHERE attention_band = 'Immediate Review' ORDER BY asset_id

examples.question: Which completed repairs were late?
examples.query: SELECT work_order_id, incident_id, repair_duration_hours FROM routing_repair_performance_mart WHERE performance_band = 'Completed Late' ORDER BY work_order_id
